description: This file defines a Python service class 'VisualizationService' responsible for generating SVG visualizations (histogram and boxplot) based on numeric data extracted from CSV or JSONL files. It interacts with a storage service to retrieve and save visualization files, and internally handles data detection, processing, and rendering.

classes.name: VisualizationService
classes.description: A service class for generating SVG visualizations such as histograms and boxplots from specified data files.

methods.name: None __init__(self, storage: StorageService)
methods.description: Initializes the VisualizationService with a StorageService instance.

methods.name: str _detect_format(self, path: Path)
methods.description: Detects the file format based on the file extension; supports CSV and JSONL.

methods.name: List[float] _load_numeric_column(self, path: Path, column: str)
methods.description: Loads numeric data from a specified column in a given file, handling CSV and JSONL formats.

methods.name: Tuple[List[float],List[int]] _histogram(self, values: List[float], bins: int)
methods.description: Calculates histogram bin edges and counts for a list of numeric values.

methods.name: Tuple[float,float,float,float,float] _boxplot_stats(self, values: List[float])
methods.description: Calculates boxplot statistics (quartiles, min, max) from a list of numeric values.

methods.name: str _render_svg_hist(self, edges: List[float], counts: List[int], width: int = 640, height: int = 360)
methods.description: Renders an SVG string representation of a histogram given bin edges and counts.

methods.name: str _render_svg_box(self, stats: Tuple[float, float, float, float, float], width: int = 640, height: int = 360)
methods.description: Renders an SVG string representation of a boxplot given boxplot statistics.

methods.name: Path generate_plot(self, filename: str, column: str, kind: str = "hist", bins: Optional[int] = 20)
methods.description: Public method to generate an SVG plot (histogram or boxplot) from a specified file and column, saving the result as a file.
